# Agent Kai

> GTM engineering as tested code. Agent Kai runs a tested, deterministic GTM engine on your CRM to recover the revenue trapped in broken pipeline data, inside your own environment, with no new vendor touching your data.

Agent Kai is a solo GTM-engineering firm. The flagship offer, Pipeline Recovery, finds dead pipeline, dedupes and re-enriches CRM data, repairs lead routing, and re-ranks accounts by recoverable revenue. It runs on a tested, deterministic decision engine (774 passing tests) executed inside the client's own environment, so no new vendor ever touches their customer data; the only AI in the loop is the Claude account the client already holds, and a fully air-gapped tier with local models is available for regulated teams. Ideal for US/EU B2B SaaS teams (50 to 1000 employees) on HubSpot or Salesforce with a rotted CRM.

## Offer

- Pipeline Audit: $3,000 fixed, 2 weeks. A quantified recovery report: how much pipeline is recoverable, where it leaks, ranked by dollars. The fee is credited into month one.
- Pipeline Recovery retainer: $10,000/month, month-to-month. Clean, enrich, re-route, reactivate dormant accounts, and report recovered pipeline monthly. Cancel anytime.
- Guarantee: if the audit doesn't surface at least 10× its fee in recoverable pipeline, it's free.

## How it works

- Score accounts as a tested function (firmographic, technographic, signal, fit), not a 100-point spreadsheet.
- Control paid spend under hard caps; route leads by data-quality score and SLA.
- Learn from closed-won/lost outcomes and re-rank the pipeline.
- Runs deterministic and auditable inside the client's environment; no new vendor in the loop. Tested code rather than a black-box tool.

## Differentiators

- Tested and deterministic: 774 passing tests, and the same inputs produce the same output every time.
- No new vendors: runs in your environment; the only AI in the loop is the Claude account you already hold. Air-gapped tier with local models on request.
- Revenue, not hygiene: every engagement is measured in recovered pipeline dollars, not dedupe counts.
